Subject: Request: Academic research credits & extended trial for NonProfit AI Lab

Hi Soojin,

I hope you’re well — I’m Elena Morales, assistant professor at Albright University leading the NonProfit AI Lab. We’re preparing a funded research project starting this fall (NSF RAISE supplement, PI: Dr. K. Patel) focused on low-resource language models for indigenous language preservation. The grant covers compute for the core infrastructure but not for large-scale inference during the evaluation phase.

We’d love to trial Redwood Inference and are requesting an education/research credit allocation or trial extension to cover model inference for an initial 6-month evaluation. Typical usage estimate: ~300k inference tokens per month for experiments and student projects.

Key constraints:
- Non-commercial, academic research only (students and PI)
- Institutional PO not issued until Oct 1; we need access sooner to prepare evals
- We can provide a letter from the PI and institutional statement of non-commercial use

Attached is a 2-page project summary and the NSF supplement notice. If there’s a standard EDU research program or promotional credit you offer, would appreciate details and any paperwork required. Happy to hop on a 20-min call this week.

Thanks —
Elena Morales
Assistant Professor, Computer Science
Albright University

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and congrats on the NSF award. Really excited by the project.

Quick notes and next steps:
- We do have an EDU Research Credits program for nonprofit academic groups. Typical one-off allocations range from $5k–$50k depending on scope; for longer evaluations we can offer a time-limited credit + extended trial.
- To speed approval, can you confirm the official project PI and a brief institutional confirmation (email from grants@albright.edu or equivalent)? Also flag whether your students will use university-managed accounts or personal emails.
- I’ve looped in Marissa (Sales Manager) and Markus (Finance) to assess a provisional credit and sign-off path.

If it helps, I can propose: 6 months of a $20k credit tied to the Albright University account, with standard non-commercial T&Cs; final approval pending finance sign-off and a signed MOU. Would that meet your immediate needs?

If yes, please send the grants office confirmation or the PI copy and we’ll move to DocuSign for the MOU. I can also schedule a short call tomorrow at 10:30 PT.
